title: adesso SE hits the Camunda-plus-public-administration intersection but is too large
content:
adesso SE sits at the intersection the screen is looking for: a public administration business above EUR 200m growing at 12%, and a Camunda practice. That combination — process orchestration in government, at a firm that already sells into it — is the shortest path from the thesis to a funded requirement. The assessment agrees, calling it the right intersection.

What rules it out is scale relative to Powerhouse's own maturity, at roughly 10,000 staff. This is a criterion about the seller rather than the buyer: an organisation that size requires an alliance process, reference architecture review and a committee, and a first design partner has to be small enough for one delivery lead to decide. The row is not saying adesso is a bad fit; it is saying the fit cannot be executed yet.

The note records a specific re-entry condition — revisit with Materna — which makes this a deferral rather than a rejection. It is also worth reading alongside the separate adesso Group row in the Flowable directory, which describes an 11,000-plus-staff DACH organisation certified across Camunda in Switzerland, Germany and Austria and carried at priority 3 rather than 9. The same group appears twice with different tool attributions and different rankings.
